strings.scene.xia.qi.title: 家天下
strings.scene.xia.qi.subtitle: 启继禹位
strings.vo.01: 禹东巡至会稽而崩，把天下交给了益。
strings.vo.02: 三年之丧毕，益让位给禹的儿子启，自己避居箕山之南。
strings.vo.03: 诸侯不去朝益，而去朝启，说：这是我们的君主、帝禹之子。
strings.vo.04: 启即天子位。有扈氏不服，启发兵讨之，大战于甘。
strings.scene.xia.qi.quote: 用命，赏于祖；弗用命，戮于社。
strings.scene.xia.qi.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.anchor.yu-beng: 禹崩于会稽，以天下授益
strings.scene.xia.qi.pick.canon: 正史 · 《史记·夏本纪》《尚书·甘誓》所载
strings.scene.xia.qi.canon.intro: 禅让到了这里改了样子。益让了，诸侯也选了。可有扈氏不认这个选择。
strings.scene.xia.qi.end.canon: 有扈氏灭，天下咸朝。自此天子之位父子相传，史称“家天下”。
strings.scene.xia.qi.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自古本《竹书纪年》佚文与《楚辞·天问》，与《史记》“益让”之说相反，属异说。
strings.scene.xia.qi.legend.intro: 汲冢出土的《竹书纪年》说：益干启位，启杀之。没有礼让，只有一场争夺。
strings.scene.xia.qi.end.legend: 益死，启立。竹书与《史记》经过相反，结果却同为启即天子位，汇流回甘之战之后。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE) · "家天下" (启继禹位)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE), c. 2070 BCE — rammed-earth platforms and palaces, pottery, turquoise inlay, Yellow River plains.

Characters:
- Qi (启) — ruler, 夏 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in c. 2070 BCE
- Yi (益) — minister, 夏 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in c. 2070 BCE
- Youhu Shi (有扈氏) — ruler, 有扈 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in c. 2070 BCE
- Yu (禹) — ruler, 夏 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in c. 2070 BCE

strings.scene.xia.xizhong.title: 夏车正
strings.scene.xia.xizhong.subtitle: 奚仲
strings.vo.01: 一千多年后，春秋的薛国大夫在诸侯的会上说：我们薛国的始祖奚仲，在夏代做车正。
strings.vo.02: 车正，管的是天下的车。木材怎样选，轮子怎样圆，车轴怎样直，都归他。
strings.vo.03: 《管子》说，奚仲造车，方的圆的曲的直的，都合乎规矩钩绳。
strings.vo.04: 车造成了，人和货物可以走得更远，打仗的方式也跟着变了。
strings.vo.05: 他把最后一根辐条敲进轮毂——
strings.scene.xia.xizhong.quote: 薛之皇祖奚仲居薛，以为夏车正。
strings.scene.xia.xizhong.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.xia.xizhong.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《左传·定公元年》所载
strings.scene.xia.xizhong.canon.intro: 《左传》提到奚仲，只为了争一个会盟时的座次。后人却从这一句里，认出了一位造车的人。
strings.scene.xia.xizhong.end.canon: 奚仲后来迁到邳，他的后人仲虺又回到薛，做了商汤的左相。薛人凭着这段家世，在定公元年的会上要求排在前面。
strings.scene.xia.xizhong.legend.disclaimer: 以下比较几种古书的说法：《荀子·解蔽》《墨子·非儒下》称“奚仲作车”；谯周《古史考》佚文（《艺文类聚》卷七十一引）称黄帝作车，少昊时加牛，禹时奚仲加马。这些是战国以后的追述，互有出入。
strings.scene.xia.xizhong.legend.intro: 黄帝的车，少昊的牛，奚仲的马。三本书，三个答案。
strings.scene.xia.xizhong.end.legend: 不论谁是第一个造车的人，到夏代的时候，车已经要专门设官来管了。汇流。
strings.scene.xia.xizhong.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若夏代无车（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.en: Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE), c. 2060 BCE — rammed-earth platforms and palaces, pottery, turquoise inlay, Yellow River plains.

characters.en: Che Gong (车工) — commoner, 夏 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; age as historically attested in c. 2060 BCE

characters.name: 仲虺
characters.zh: 仲虺（薛·奚仲后裔）：麻布交领短衣，玉璋玉钺，初现的青铜饰物；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；年龄依史实（此时为夏初（无确年））；居薛，后为商汤左相
characters.en: Zhong Hui (仲虺) — minister, 薛 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in c. 2060 BCE

characters.name: 薛宰
characters.zh: 薛宰（薛·春秋时薛国大夫）：麻布交领短衣，玉璋玉钺，初现的青铜饰物；文臣朝服与官帽，持笏或文书；年龄依史实（此时为夏初（无确年））；在鲁定公元年的会上追述先祖
characters.en: Xue Zai (薛宰) — minister, 薛 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in c. 2060 BCE

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「夏车正」，副题「奚仲」，朱印「车正」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「薛之皇祖奚仲居薛，以为夏车正。」——《左传·定公元年》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

narration: 一千多年后，春秋的薛国大夫在诸侯的会上说：我们薛国的始祖奚仲，在夏代做车正。车正，管的是天下的车。木材怎样选，轮子怎样圆，车轴怎样直，都归他。
《管子》说，奚仲造车，方的圆的曲的直的，都合乎规矩钩绳。
车造成了，人和货物可以走得更远，打仗的方式也跟着变了。
他把最后一根辐条敲进轮毂——
奚仲后来迁到邳，他的后人仲虺又回到薛，做了商汤的左相。薛人凭着这段家世，在定公元年的会上要求排在前面。
薛之皇祖奚仲居薛，以为夏车正。

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE) · "夏车正" (奚仲)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE), c. 2060 BCE — rammed-earth platforms and palaces, pottery, turquoise inlay, Yellow River plains.

Characters:
- Xi Zhong (奚仲) — minister, 薛 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in c. 2060 BCE
- Che Gong (车工) — commoner, 夏 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; age as historically attested in c. 2060 BCE
- Zhong Hui (仲虺) — minister, 薛 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in c. 2060 BCE
- Xue Zai (薛宰) — minister, 薛 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in c. 2060 BCE

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: trees, tree canopy, near hills and ground | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 薛地的山林，伐木声此起彼伏 | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: birdsong; SFX: wood chopping | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「夏车正」 with vermilion seal 「车正」
Shot 2 (10–26 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: 规矩; subject: Xi Zhong | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 他在木材上弹出墨线，比着规矩下斧 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: wood chopping | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「一千多年后，春秋的薛国大夫在诸侯的会上说：我们薛国的始祖奚仲，在夏代做车正。车正，管的是天下的车。木材怎样选，轮子怎样圆，车轴怎样直，都归他。」
Shot 3 (26–50 s, 24 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: grass; subject: Che Gong | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 一只车轮立起，滚过泥地 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: cart wheels | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「薛之皇祖奚仲居薛，以为夏车正。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「《管子》说，奚仲造车，方的圆的曲的直的，都合乎规矩钩绳。」
Shot 4 (50–78 s, 28 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: distant mountains; subject: cavalry, banners | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 车队载着贡物，驶向夏都 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; ink dispersing outward like hoofprints in wet ink | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains; SFX: hoofbeats | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「车造成了，人和货物可以走得更远，打仗的方式也跟着变了。」
Shot 5 (78–90 s, 12 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: subject: Xi Zhong; dry-brush calligraphy 「车正」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 轴与轮咬合，车身一稳 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: quiet room tone; SFX: cart wheels | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他把最后一根辐条敲进轮毂——」
Shot 6 (90–100 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; figures: Xi Zhong | Action: (canonical outcome, Chinese) 奚仲后来迁到邳，他的后人仲虺又回到薛，做了商汤的左相。薛人凭着这段家世，在定公元年的会上要求排在前面。 | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「奚仲后来迁到邳，他的后人仲虺又回到薛，做了商汤的左相。薛人凭着这段家世，在定公元年的会上要求排在前面。」
Shot 7 (100–106 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「薛之皇祖奚仲居薛，以为夏车正。」 signed 《左传·定公元年》; vermilion seal 「车正」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「薛之皇祖奚仲居薛，以为夏车正。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: birdsong, quiet room tone, wind over open plains; SFX: wood chopping, cart wheels, hoofbeats; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「夏车正」, subtitle 「奚仲」, vermilion seal 「车正」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「薛之皇祖奚仲居薛，以为夏车正。」 — 《左传·定公元年》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.xia.shaokang.title: 少康中兴
strings.scene.xia.shaokang.subtitle: 有穷之乱
strings.vo.01: 夏启之后，太康失国。有穷氏后羿因夏民而代夏政。
strings.vo.02: 后羿恃其善射，不修民事；其相寒浞杀之，据其室，又使子浇灭夏后相。
strings.vo.03: 相之妻后缗方有身孕，自墙洞逃出，归于母家有仍。
strings.vo.04: 遗腹之子少康长大，先为牧正，后奔有虞，有田一成，有众一旅。
strings.vo.05: 他派女艾潜入浇的营中——
strings.scene.xia.shaokang.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.xia.shaokang.canon.intro: 少康手里只有方十里的田、五百人的众。他不能硬拼，先要弄清浇的营里谁在守夜。
strings.scene.xia.shaokang.end.canon: 浇与豷相继覆灭，少康复禹之绩，夏祀不绝。
strings.scene.xia.shaokang.legend.disclaimer: 以下为神话。神话中射日的羿与有穷氏后羿是否一人，古来混说，史家多以为非一人。
strings.scene.xia.shaokang.legend.intro: 神话说：尧时十日并出，草木焦枯，羿上射十日，下除猛兽。后世常把这位羿与篡夏的后羿混为一谈。
strings.scene.xia.shaokang.end.legend: 射日的英雄与篡夏的国君，在后世笔下叠成一人。画卷合上，回到少康复国。

背景：纯透明（alpha 通道；无纸纹、无底色、无投影、无环境光），每格可整格抠图。
版式：3×2 均匀网格，自上而下、自左而右排列；每格只放一件完整独立素材，居中等大、四周留白、互不重叠、风格统一。
清单：
第 1 行：1. 泼墨墨点飞溅；2. 飞白笔触；3. 箭矢破空。
第 2 行：4. 命中靶心墨点；5. 烟（过场笔画所绘）；6. 留空。
排版参考尺寸：1536×1024 像素，每格按 512×512 切分；实际生成尺寸以所用服务返回值为准，裁切前须确认比例与透明通道。只有墨线与墨块，不加任何文字、书法、印章、边框、网格线、水印。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE) · "少康中兴" (有穷之乱)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE), c. 2050 BCE — rammed-earth platforms and palaces, pottery, turquoise inlay, Yellow River plains.

Characters:
- Shao Kang (少康) — ruler, 夏 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in c. 2050 BCE
- Hou Min (后缗) — royal / consort, 夏 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; rich court dress, elaborate hair ornaments; age as historically attested in c. 2050 BCE
- Hou Yi (后羿) — ruler, 有穷 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in c. 2050 BCE
- Han Zhuo (寒浞) — minister, 有穷 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in c. 2050 BCE
- Jiao (浇) — general, 有穷 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; general in full armour, sword or weapon in hand; age as historically attested in c. 2050 BCE
- Nü Ai (女艾) — commoner, 夏 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; age as historically attested in c. 2050 BCE
- Yu Si (虞思) — ruler, 有虞 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in c. 2050 BCE

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: distant mountains; midground: near hills and ground, smoke | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 夏都残破，远山之下烟起 | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: wind over open plains | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「少康中兴」 with vermilion seal 「复禹之绩」
Shot 2 (10–26 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: subject: Hou Yi, Han Zhuo, bow | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 后羿恃射，寒浞夺其室 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: bowstring | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「夏启之后，太康失国。有穷氏后羿因夏民而代夏政。后羿恃其善射，不修民事；其相寒浞杀之，据其室，又使子浇灭夏后相。」
Shot 3 (26–50 s, 24 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: grass; subject: Hou Min; dry-brush calligraphy 「雨」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 后缗自墙洞逃出，奔有仍 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: light rain; SFX: footsteps | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「相之妻后缗方有身孕，自墙洞逃出，归于母家有仍。」
Shot 4 (50–78 s, 28 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: army tents; subject: Shao Kang, crowd | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 少康为牧正、庖正，有田一成，有众一旅 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: village ambience; SFX: crackling fire | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「遗腹之子少康长大，先为牧正，后奔有虞，有田一成，有众一旅。」
Shot 5 (78–90 s, 12 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: background: moon; dry-brush calligraphy 「夜袭之箭」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 女艾入浇营：一箭破夜 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; vignette closing in from the corners; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: arrow release | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「他派女艾潜入浇的营中——」
Shot 6 (90–100 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: (canonical outcome, Chinese) 浇与豷相继覆灭，少康复禹之绩，夏祀不绝。 | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「浇与豷相继覆灭，少康复禹之绩，夏祀不绝。」
Shot 7 (100–106 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation; vermilion seal 「复禹之绩」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source

Sound: Music: xun clay ocarina, ancient and desolate, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: wind over open plains, palace hall reverb, light rain, village ambience, night wind; SFX: bowstring, footsteps, crackling fire, arrow release; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「少康中兴」, subtitle 「有穷之乱」, vermilion seal 「复禹之绩」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

Negative prompt: photorealistic, 3D render, CGI look, thick oil paint, cyberpunk, anime faces, beauty-filter faces, neon oversaturated colours, modern buildings, modern clothing, cars, power lines, plastic texture, Latin letters, garbled text, misspelled characters, watermark, signature, logo, extra limbs, malformed hands, distorted faces, flickering characters, jitter and tearing, anachronisms: Qing queues and magua jackets, futou caps and round-collar robes, iron plate armour and stirrups

strings.scene.xia.jiuding.title: 铸鼎象物
strings.scene.xia.jiuding.subtitle: 九鼎
strings.vo.01: 九鼎的来历，最早是由一位周朝大夫讲出来的。
strings.vo.02: 他说，从前夏朝正有德的时候，远方的人把各地的山川物象画成图，九州的长官进贡铜料。
strings.vo.03: 用这些铜铸成鼎，把百物的形象铸在上面，让百姓认得哪些是神，哪些是奸怪。
strings.vo.04: 讲这番话的那一年，楚庄王的大军就驻在周的边境上，派人来问鼎有多大、有多重。
strings.vo.05: 王孙满看着来使，开了口——
strings.scene.xia.jiuding.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.xia.jiuding.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《左传·宣公三年》所载
strings.scene.xia.jiuding.canon.intro: 九鼎铸于夏，可它的故事要到春秋才有人讲。这一段以王孙满的追述为线，走回夏初的铸铜场。
strings.scene.xia.jiuding.end.canon: 楚使无言而退。王孙满说：鼎随德而迁，夏桀昏德，鼎迁于商；商纣暴虐，鼎迁于周。周德虽衰，天命未改，鼎之轻重，未可问也。
strings.scene.xia.jiuding.pick.legend: 后世 · 九鼎与《山海经》
strings.scene.xia.jiuding.legend.disclaimer: 以下取《史记·封禅书》“禹收九牧之金，铸九鼎”，以及后人以《山海经》为九鼎图像说明的说法（宋代以后学者多有此论，未有定说）。这些都不是夏代的记录。
strings.scene.xia.jiuding.legend.intro: 后世有人说，鼎上铸的百物，就是《山海经》里那些奇形怪状的山神与异兽。翻开书，就像在摸那只鼎。
strings.scene.xia.jiuding.end.legend: 不管鼎是禹铸还是夏人铸，到春秋时它已是天命的象征。汇流。
strings.scene.xia.jiuding.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若王孙满答出了鼎的重量（未开放）

[Ink-wash video prompt] Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE) · "铸鼎象物" (九鼎)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE), c. 2040 BCE — rammed-earth platforms and palaces, pottery, turquoise inlay, Yellow River plains.

Characters:
- Wang Sunman (王孙满) — minister, 周 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in c. 2040 BCE
- Chu Zhuangwang (楚庄王) — ruler, 楚 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in c. 2040 BCE
- Jiu Mu (九牧) — minister, 夏 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in c. 2040 BCE

strings.scene.xia.kongjia.title: 御龙氏
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.subtitle: 孔甲
strings.vo.01: 孔甲即位的时候，夏朝已经衰落，诸侯渐渐离心。
strings.vo.02: 他喜好鬼神。《夏本纪》说，天降下两条龙，一雌一雄，孔甲却找不到会养龙的人。
strings.vo.03: 陶唐氏的后人刘累，学过驯龙的本事，前来侍奉孔甲。孔甲赐他姓御龙氏。
strings.vo.04: 后来雌龙死了。刘累不敢声张，把龙肉做成肉酱，献给了孔甲。
strings.vo.05: 孔甲吃完，又派人来要龙——
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《史记·夏本纪》《左传·昭公二十九年》所载
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.canon.intro: 龙出现在正史里，听起来像神话。太史公照着《左传》的旧说写了下来，用它说明一件事：夏德已衰。
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.end.canon: 刘累惧而迁去，到了鲁县。《夏本纪》接着写道：孔甲崩，子帝皋立；三传至桀，夏亡。
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.pick.legend: 野史 · 萯山破斧之歌
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.legend.disclaimer: 以下取《吕氏春秋·音初》：孔甲田猎于东阳萯山，遇大风入民家，所收养的孩子后来因斧伤足，孔甲作《破斧之歌》，是为“东音”之始。这是战国秦汉间的传说。
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.legend.intro: 东阳萯山，大风骤起，天昏地暗。孔甲迷了路，走进了一户正在生孩子的人家。
strings.scene.xia.kongjia.end.legend: 一个说孔甲贪龙，一个说孔甲作歌。两种传说都发生在夏德衰落之时。汇流。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 夏 · （夏代后期（无确年））。夯土台基与宫室、陶器、绿松石器、黄河与伊洛平原。
setting.en: Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE), c. 1750 BCE — rammed-earth platforms and palaces, pottery, turquoise inlay, Yellow River plains.

characters.name: 孔甲
characters.zh: 孔甲（夏·夏王）：麻布交领短衣，玉璋玉钺，初现的青铜饰物；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；年龄依史实（此时为夏代后期（无确年））；好方鬼神，事淫乱，夏后氏德衰
characters.en: Kong Jia (孔甲) — ruler, 夏 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in c. 1750 BCE

characters.name: 刘累
characters.zh: 刘累（陶唐氏后裔·御龙氏）：麻布交领短衣，玉璋玉钺，初现的青铜饰物；女子衣着，依身份；年龄依史实（此时为夏代后期（无确年））；学扰龙于豢龙氏，以事孔甲
characters.en: Liu Lei (刘累) — commoner, 陶唐氏后裔 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; female dress appropriate to rank; age as historically attested in c. 1750 BCE

characters.name: 蔡墨

characters.en: Cai Mo (蔡墨) — scholar, 晋 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; age as historically attested in c. 1750 BCE

shots.zh: 镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：云；中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：水｜动作：宫中池水翻动，水下隐约有鳞｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：水势奔涌｜屏幕文字：片名「御龙氏」竖排书法与朱印「豢龙」

shots.vo: 孔甲即位的时候，夏朝已经衰落，诸侯渐渐离心。他喜好鬼神。《夏本纪》说，天降下两条龙，一雌一雄，孔甲却找不到会养龙的人。
shots.zh: 镜头 2（10–26 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：烟；主体：孔甲、火｜动作：孔甲在祭坛前焚香，求问鬼神｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）；热浪与烟气扭曲｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：鼓声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孔甲即位的时候，夏朝已经衰落，诸侯渐渐离心。他喜好鬼神。《夏本纪》说，天降下两条龙，一雌一雄，孔甲却找不到会养龙的人。」
shots.en: Shot 2 (10–26 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: smoke; subject: Kong Jia, fire (splashed ink) | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 孔甲在祭坛前焚香，求问鬼神 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: drum | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孔甲即位的时候，夏朝已经衰落，诸侯渐渐离心。他喜好鬼神。《夏本纪》说，天降下两条龙，一雌一雄，孔甲却找不到会养龙的人。」

shots.vo: 陶唐氏的后人刘累，学过驯龙的本事，前来侍奉孔甲。孔甲赐他姓御龙氏。
shots.zh: 镜头 3（26–50 秒，24 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：关门；主体：刘累｜动作：一个自称会养龙的人走进宫门｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）｜声音：环境：脚步声；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：引文「孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「陶唐氏的后人刘累，学过驯龙的本事，前来侍奉孔甲。孔甲赐他姓御龙氏。」
shots.en: Shot 3 (26–50 s, 24 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: gate; subject: Liu Lei | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 一个自称会养龙的人走进宫门 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: footsteps; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「陶唐氏的后人刘累，学过驯龙的本事，前来侍奉孔甲。孔甲赐他姓御龙氏。」

shots.vo: 后来雌龙死了。刘累不敢声张，把龙肉做成肉酱，献给了孔甲。
shots.zh: 镜头 4（50–78 秒，28 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：月；主体：刘累、水｜动作：池边，一条雌龙不再游动｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：水花｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「后来雌龙死了。刘累不敢声张，把龙肉做成肉酱，献给了孔甲。」
shots.en: Shot 4 (50–78 s, 28 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon; subject: Liu Lei, water | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 池边，一条雌龙不再游动 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: water splash | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「后来雌龙死了。刘累不敢声张，把龙肉做成肉酱，献给了孔甲。」

shots.vo: 孔甲吃完，又派人来要龙——
shots.zh: 镜头 5（78–90 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：河水、舟；飞白题字「迁」｜动作：他连夜逃出了夏都｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）；四角暗角收拢；水墨流动晕染；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：雷声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孔甲吃完，又派人来要龙——」
shots.en: Shot 5 (78–90 s, 12 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river, boat; dry-brush calligraphy 「迁」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 他连夜逃出了夏都 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: thunder | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孔甲吃完，又派人来要龙——」

shots.vo: 刘累惧而迁去，到了鲁县。《夏本纪》接着写道：孔甲崩，子帝皋立；三传至桀，夏亡。

shots.vo: 孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。
shots.zh: 镜头 7（100–106 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。」，下署《史记·夏本纪》；右下角朱印「豢龙」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。」

sound.zh: 背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：平缓河水、宫殿回响、脚步声、夜风；音效：水势奔涌、鼓声、青铜钟声、水花、雷声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。
sound.en: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: calm river, palace hall reverb, footsteps, night wind; SFX: surging water, drum, bronze bell, water splash, thunder; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

onScreenText.zh: 片头：右上竖排书法片名「御龙氏」，副题「孔甲」，朱印「豢龙」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。」——《史记·夏本纪》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

narration: 孔甲即位的时候，夏朝已经衰落，诸侯渐渐离心。他喜好鬼神。《夏本纪》说，天降下两条龙，一雌一雄，孔甲却找不到会养龙的人。
陶唐氏的后人刘累，学过驯龙的本事，前来侍奉孔甲。孔甲赐他姓御龙氏。
后来雌龙死了。刘累不敢声张，把龙肉做成肉酱，献给了孔甲。
孔甲吃完，又派人来要龙——
刘累惧而迁去，到了鲁县。《夏本纪》接着写道：孔甲崩，子帝皋立；三传至桀，夏亡。
孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。

prompt.zh:
【水墨视频生成提示词】夏 · 御龙氏（孔甲）

画幅与时长：16:9 横屏（1920×1080，竖屏可改 9:16 并保持主体居中），24fps，总长约 106 秒，共 7 个镜头；单镜时长超出生成器上限时可逐镜生成后剪辑。

风格：中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。

时代与场景：夏 · （夏代后期（无确年））。夯土台基与宫室、陶器、绿松石器、黄河与伊洛平原。

人物：
- 孔甲（夏·夏王）：麻布交领短衣，玉璋玉钺，初现的青铜饰物；君主装束，冠冕或礼服，神情威严；年龄依史实（此时为夏代后期（无确年））；好方鬼神，事淫乱，夏后氏德衰
- 刘累（陶唐氏后裔·御龙氏）：麻布交领短衣，玉璋玉钺，初现的青铜饰物；女子衣着，依身份；年龄依史实（此时为夏代后期（无确年））；学扰龙于豢龙氏，以事孔甲
- 蔡墨（晋·晋太史）：麻布交领短衣，玉璋玉钺，初现的青铜饰物；文士衣冠，素色长衫，书卷气；年龄依史实（此时为夏代后期（无确年））；鲁昭公二十九年向魏献子讲述豢龙旧事
- 萯山民家（夏·东阳萯山人）：麻布交领短衣，玉璋玉钺，初现的青铜饰物；依身份的平民、工匠、侍从或兵卒衣着；年龄依史实（此时为夏代后期（无确年））；孔甲避风雨时所入之家

分镜：
镜头 1（0–10 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：固定机位远景长镜，画面静止，墨色缓缓显现｜构图：远景：云；中景：殿柱、屋檐；主体：水｜动作：宫中池水翻动，水下隐约有鳞｜水墨效果：宣纸留白淡入｜声音：环境：平缓河水；音效：水势奔涌｜屏幕文字：片名「御龙氏」竖排书法与朱印「豢龙」
镜头 2（10–26 秒，16 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：中景：烟；主体：孔甲、火｜动作：孔甲在祭坛前焚香，求问鬼神｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）；热浪与烟气扭曲｜声音：环境：宫殿回响；音效：鼓声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孔甲即位的时候，夏朝已经衰落，诸侯渐渐离心。他喜好鬼神。《夏本纪》说，天降下两条龙，一雌一雄，孔甲却找不到会养龙的人。」
镜头 3（26–50 秒，24 秒）｜运镜：缓慢推近，景深变浅，主体渐清｜构图：中景：关门；主体：刘累｜动作：一个自称会养龙的人走进宫门｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）｜声音：环境：脚步声；音效：青铜钟声｜屏幕文字：引文「孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。」竖排楷书；底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「陶唐氏的后人刘累，学过驯龙的本事，前来侍奉孔甲。孔甲赐他姓御龙氏。」
镜头 4（50–78 秒，28 秒）｜运镜：缓慢横移（摇镜），沿画卷方向展开｜构图：远景：月；主体：刘累、水｜动作：池边，一条雌龙不再游动｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：水花｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「后来雌龙死了。刘累不敢声张，把龙肉做成肉酱，献给了孔甲。」
镜头 5（78–90 秒，12 秒）｜运镜：急推特写后定格，轻微震屏｜构图：中景：河水、舟；飞白题字「迁」｜动作：他连夜逃出了夏都｜水墨效果：墨晕转场（上一镜墨色晕开化入本镜）；四角暗角收拢；水墨流动晕染；画面定格成一幅水墨画；泼墨飞溅，朱砂一点｜声音：环境：夜风；音效：雷声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「孔甲吃完，又派人来要龙——」
镜头 6（90–100 秒，10 秒）｜运镜：缓慢拉远成全景，画面如长卷收束｜构图：主体退为远景中的小小身影，四周大片留白；山河远景｜动作：正史结局：刘累惧而迁去，到了鲁县。《夏本纪》接着写道：孔甲崩，子帝皋立；三传至桀，夏亡。｜水墨效果：墨色由浓转淡，水痕慢慢洇开，余墨流向画外｜声音：背景乐回落，余音与环境声｜屏幕文字：底部旁白字幕｜旁白：「刘累惧而迁去，到了鲁县。《夏本纪》接着写道：孔甲崩，子帝皋立；三传至桀，夏亡。」
镜头 7（100–106 秒，6 秒）｜运镜：固定机位，空镜｜构图：空白宣纸上，左侧竖排楷书引文「孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。」，下署《史记·夏本纪》；右下角朱印「豢龙」｜动作：引文逐字写出，最后朱印落下｜水墨效果：毛笔逐笔书写，朱砂印泥微微渗开｜声音：印章落纸一声，琴声收尾｜屏幕文字：引文与出处｜旁白：「孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。」

声音：背景乐：古琴，清远沉静，随剧情由缓入急、高潮前骤停留白；环境声：平缓河水、宫殿回响、脚步声、夜风；音效：水势奔涌、鼓声、青铜钟声、水花、雷声；旁白：普通话，沉稳舒缓的纪录片语气，逐镜如下。

字幕与屏幕文字：片头：右上竖排书法片名「御龙氏」，副题「孔甲」，朱印「豢龙」；旁白字幕：简体中文，底部居中，楷体或宋体，白底留边；引文：「孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。」——《史记·夏本纪》，竖排楷书；所有文字必须准确，不得出现错字、乱码或英文。

负面提示词：写实照片，3D 渲染，CG 质感，油画厚涂，赛博朋克，日式动漫脸，美颜网红脸，高饱和霓虹色，现代建筑，现代服饰，汽车电线，塑料质感，英文字母，乱码文字，错别字，水印，签名，logo，多余肢体，手指畸形，五官崩坏，人物变形闪烁，画面抖动撕裂，时代错置：清代辫发与马褂、幞头与圆领袍、铁甲与马镫
prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE) · "御龙氏" (孔甲)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE), c. 1750 BCE — rammed-earth platforms and palaces, pottery, turquoise inlay, Yellow River plains.

Characters:
- Kong Jia (孔甲) — ruler, 夏 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in c. 1750 BCE
- Liu Lei (刘累) — commoner, 陶唐氏后裔 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; female dress appropriate to rank; age as historically attested in c. 1750 BCE
- Cai Mo (蔡墨) — scholar, 晋 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; age as historically attested in c. 1750 BCE
- Fu Shanminjia (萯山民家) — commoner, 夏 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; commoner, artisan, attendant or soldier clothing as appropriate; age as historically attested in c. 1750 BCE

Storyboard:
Shot 1 (0–10 s, 10 s) | Camera: locked-off wide shot, stillness as the ink slowly appears | Composition: background: clouds; midground: palace pillars, palace eaves; subject: water | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 宫中池水翻动，水下隐约有鳞 | Ink FX: fade in from blank xuan paper | Sound: ambience: calm river; SFX: surging water | On-screen text: vertical brush-calligraphy title 「御龙氏」 with vermilion seal 「豢龙」
Shot 2 (10–26 s, 16 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: midground: smoke; subject: Kong Jia, fire (splashed ink) | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 孔甲在祭坛前焚香，求问鬼神 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; heat-haze and smoke distortion | Sound: ambience: palace hall reverb; SFX: drum | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孔甲即位的时候，夏朝已经衰落，诸侯渐渐离心。他喜好鬼神。《夏本纪》说，天降下两条龙，一雌一雄，孔甲却找不到会养龙的人。」
Shot 3 (26–50 s, 24 s) | Camera: slow push-in, shallow depth of field, subject sharpening | Composition: midground: gate; subject: Liu Lei | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 一个自称会养龙的人走进宫门 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: footsteps; SFX: bronze bell | On-screen text: vertical kaishu quotation 「孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。」; Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「陶唐氏的后人刘累，学过驯龙的本事，前来侍奉孔甲。孔甲赐他姓御龙氏。」
Shot 4 (50–78 s, 28 s) | Camera: slow lateral pan, unrolling like a handscroll | Composition: background: moon; subject: Liu Lei, water | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 池边，一条雌龙不再游动 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: water splash | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「后来雌龙死了。刘累不敢声张，把龙肉做成肉酱，献给了孔甲。」
Shot 5 (78–90 s, 12 s) | Camera: fast push to close-up, slight shake, then freeze-frame | Composition: midground: river, boat; dry-brush calligraphy 「迁」 | Action: (scene action, Chinese) 他连夜逃出了夏都 | Ink FX: ink-bleed transition from the previous shot; vignette closing in from the corners; flowing ink wash bleeding across the paper; freeze into a still ink painting; ink splash with a single vermilion accent | Sound: ambience: night wind; SFX: thunder | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「孔甲吃完，又派人来要龙——」
Shot 6 (90–100 s, 10 s) | Camera: slow pull-back to a wide shot, closing like a handscroll | Composition: the subject recedes into a tiny figure amid vast empty paper; distant landscape | Action: (canonical outcome, Chinese) 刘累惧而迁去，到了鲁县。《夏本纪》接着写道：孔甲崩，子帝皋立；三传至桀，夏亡。 | Ink FX: ink fades from dense to pale, water marks spreading, residual ink drifting off-frame | Sound: music settles, lingering tail and ambience | On-screen text: Chinese subtitles at bottom | VO (Mandarin): 「刘累惧而迁去，到了鲁县。《夏本纪》接着写道：孔甲崩，子帝皋立；三传至桀，夏亡。」
Shot 7 (100–106 s, 6 s) | Camera: locked-off empty frame | Composition: blank xuan paper; a vertical kaishu quotation 「孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。」 signed 《史记·夏本纪》; vermilion seal 「豢龙」 at lower right | Action: the quotation writes itself stroke by stroke; the vermilion seal stamps last | Ink FX: brush writes stroke by stroke, vermilion seal paste slightly bleeding | Sound: a soft seal stamp, the music ends | On-screen text: quotation and its source | VO (Mandarin): 「孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。」

Sound: Music: guqin zither, serene and distant, building gradually and cutting to silence before the climax; ambience: calm river, palace hall reverb, footsteps, night wind; SFX: surging water, drum, bronze bell, water splash, thunder; narration: calm Mandarin documentary voice-over (lines given per shot, keep them in Chinese).

On-screen text: Title: vertical brush calligraphy 「御龙氏」, subtitle 「孔甲」, vermilion seal 「豢龙」 at upper right; subtitles: Simplified Chinese, bottom centre; quotation 「孔甲赐之姓曰御龙氏。」 — 《史记·夏本纪》, vertical kaishu; all Chinese text must be exact, no garbled or Latin text.

strings.scene.xia.erlitou.title: 最早的宫城
strings.scene.xia.erlitou.subtitle: 二里头
strings.vo.01: 古书里的夏都，到底在哪里？两千年来，没有人见过。
strings.vo.02: 1959 年，史学家徐旭生带队到豫西寻找“夏墟”，在偃师二里头村发现了一片很大的遗址。
strings.vo.03: 此后几十年，考古学者在这里找到了宫殿基址、纵横的道路、围起的宫城和铸铜作坊。
strings.vo.04: 2002 年，一座墓里出土了一件用两千多片绿松石拼成的龙形器。
strings.vo.05: 可是，这里有没有留下一个字，告诉我们它叫“夏”——
strings.scene.xia.erlitou.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.xia.erlitou.pick.canon: 正史线 · 考古发掘所见
strings.scene.xia.erlitou.canon.intro: 这一段的“正史”不是书，而是土。地层、陶片、夯土和碳十四数据，是这里唯一的史料。
strings.scene.xia.erlitou.end.canon: 二里头有了宫城，有了青铜礼器，有了龙。它的年代落在古书所说的夏代纪年之内，但遗址里没有发现文字，它是不是夏都，至今仍是推论。
strings.scene.xia.erlitou.pick.legend: 异说 · 二里头是不是夏
strings.scene.xia.erlitou.legend.disclaimer: 以下介绍学界对二里头性质的不同看法：一种认为它就是夏代晚期都城（如斟鄩），一种认为在出土文字证据之前只能称“二里头文化”，还有学者认为其晚期已入商。这些是现代学术讨论，本段只概述，不引现代著作原文。
strings.scene.xia.erlitou.legend.intro: 同一片遗址，有人说它叫斟鄩，有人说它只能叫二里头。在这一条线上，你要替双方各写一张说明牌。
strings.scene.xia.erlitou.end.legend: 说明牌写完了，土里的龙仍然没有名字。这一条线不改变任何史实，只提醒：证据到哪里，结论就到哪里。汇流。
strings.scene.xia.erlitou.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若二里头出土了文字（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

setting.zh: 夏 · （约前 1750—前 1520 年）。夯土台基与宫室、陶器、绿松石器、黄河与伊洛平原。
setting.en: Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE), c. 1735 BCE — rammed-earth platforms and palaces, pottery, turquoise inlay, Yellow River plains.

characters.name: 徐旭生

characters.en: Xu Xusheng (徐旭生) — scholar, 现代 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; scholar's plain long robe, bookish bearing; age as historically attested in c. 1735 BCE

characters.name: 二里头先民

narration: 古书里的夏都，到底在哪里？两千年来，没有人见过。1959 年，史学家徐旭生带队到豫西寻找“夏墟”，在偃师二里头村发现了一片很大的遗址。
此后几十年，考古学者在这里找到了宫殿基址、纵横的道路、围起的宫城和铸铜作坊。
2002 年，一座墓里出土了一件用两千多片绿松石拼成的龙形器。
可是，这里有没有留下一个字，告诉我们它叫“夏”——
二里头有了宫城，有了青铜礼器，有了龙。它的年代落在古书所说的夏代纪年之内，但遗址里没有发现文字，它是不是夏都，至今仍是推论。

strings.scene.xia.meixi.title: 有施之女
strings.scene.xia.meixi.subtitle: 妹喜
strings.vo.01: 夏的最后一个王叫桀。《史记》说他不修德行，用武力伤害百姓，百姓不堪忍受。
strings.vo.02: 晋国的史苏后来讲过：桀攻打有施氏，有施人把一个叫妹喜的女子献给了他。
strings.vo.03: 妹喜得宠。可古本《竹书纪年》又说，桀后来攻打岷山，得到了琬、琰二女，就把妹喜丢在了洛水边。
strings.vo.04: 被冷落的妹喜，据说与远方商国来的伊尹有了往来。
strings.scene.xia.meixi.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.xia.meixi.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《国语·晋语一》《史记·夏本纪》所载
strings.scene.xia.meixi.canon.intro: 在《国语》里，妹喜是一则讲给国君听的警告：女色亡国。这一段先照原书讲，再在史评里把这种说法摆上来看。
strings.scene.xia.meixi.end.canon: 史苏对晋献公说：夏桀伐有施，得妹喜，妹喜与伊尹比而亡夏。献公没有听，后来骊姬之乱几乎亡晋。
strings.scene.xia.meixi.legend.disclaimer: 以下取西汉刘向《列女传·孽嬖传·夏桀末喜》“为酒池可以运舟”，以及皇甫谧《帝王世纪》“末喜好闻裂缯之声而笑”（《太平御览》卷一百三十五引）。这些是汉晋人的渲染，把亡国之罪归于女子，史评另有讨论。
strings.scene.xia.meixi.legend.intro: 宫中挖了一个大池，盛满了酒，池上可以行船。鼓声一响，三千人俯身像牛一样饮酒。
strings.scene.xia.meixi.end.legend: 酒池的故事越传越长，妹喜的面目越来越模糊。夏还是亡了，亡在桀自己手里。汇流。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

narration: 夏的最后一个王叫桀。《史记》说他不修德行，用武力伤害百姓，百姓不堪忍受。晋国的史苏后来讲过：桀攻打有施氏，有施人把一个叫妹喜的女子献给了他。
妹喜得宠。可古本《竹书纪年》又说，桀后来攻打岷山，得到了琬、琰二女，就把妹喜丢在了洛水边。
被冷落的妹喜，据说与远方商国来的伊尹有了往来。
小船离开了岸——

strings.scene.xia.xiatai.title: 囚汤夏台
strings.scene.xia.xiatai.subtitle: 桀与汤
strings.vo.01: 汤是商国的首领。他施行德政，周边的诸侯渐渐都来归附。
strings.vo.02: 夏桀起了疑心，把汤召到夏都，关进了一座叫夏台的牢狱。
strings.vo.03: 太史公只写了一句：已而释之。至于关了多久，怎么放出来的，书里没说。
strings.vo.04: 有人说是商人送了重礼，有人说是桀自己改了主意。
strings.scene.xia.xiatai.quote: 乃召汤而囚之夏台，已而释之。
strings.scene.xia.xiatai.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.xia.xiatai.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《史记·夏本纪》所载
strings.scene.xia.xiatai.canon.intro: 《史记》里的这一段只有十几个字。夏台在哪里，后世注家说法不同，司马贞《索隐》说它是夏代的狱名。
strings.scene.xia.xiatai.end.canon: 汤回到商国，更加修德。《夏本纪》说：汤修德，诸侯皆归汤，汤遂率兵以伐夏桀。
strings.scene.xia.xiatai.pick.legend: 异说 · 今本《竹书纪年》的年份
strings.scene.xia.xiatai.legend.disclaimer: 以下取今本《竹书纪年·夏纪》：把“商侯履来朝，命囚履于夏台”与“释商侯履”分系于帝癸二十二年、二十三年。今本《竹书纪年》学界多认为是宋以后重编，其年份不可据信，这里只作“异说”展示。
strings.scene.xia.xiatai.legend.intro: 今本竹书给这件事排了两个年份：二十二年囚，二十三年释。中间的一年，史书一字没有。
strings.scene.xia.xiatai.end.legend: 无论囚了几天还是一年，汤出了夏台，夏的气数就尽了。汇流。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE) · "囚汤夏台" (桀与汤)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE), c. 1625 BCE — rammed-earth platforms and palaces, pottery, turquoise inlay, Yellow River plains.

Characters:
- Tang (汤) — ruler, 商 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in c. 1625 BCE
- Yi Yin (伊尹) — minister, 商 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in c. 1625 BCE
- Jie (桀) — ruler, 夏 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in c. 1625 BCE
- Zhong Hui (仲虺) — minister, 商 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; civil official's court robe and cap, holding a tablet or documents; age as historically attested in c. 1625 BCE

strings.scene.xia.yiyin.title: 负鼎俎
strings.scene.xia.yiyin.subtitle: 伊尹
strings.vo.01: 《殷本纪》里，伊尹最初只是一名陪嫁的厨子。
strings.vo.02: 有莘氏把女儿嫁给汤，伊尹背着鼎和砧板跟了过来。他借着讲烹调的滋味，向汤讲治国的道理。
strings.vo.03: 汤任用了他。可伊尹又离开商，到夏去了一趟。
strings.vo.04: 孟子说，伊尹五次去汤那里，五次去桀那里。
strings.vo.05: 这一次，他在夏都看够了——
strings.scene.xia.yiyin.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.xia.yiyin.pick.canon: 正史线 · 《史记·殷本纪》所载
strings.scene.xia.yiyin.canon.intro: 太史公对伊尹的出身给了两种说法：一说他是媵臣，一说他是隐士，汤派人五次聘请才来。这一段按第一种说法走。
strings.scene.xia.yiyin.end.canon: 伊尹既丑有夏，复归于亳。他把在夏都看到的一切告诉了汤。不久，汤征葛伯，伐夏之战开始了。
strings.scene.xia.yiyin.legend.disclaimer: 以下取《吕氏春秋·孝行览·本味》：有侁氏女子采桑，得婴儿于空桑之中，即伊尹；其母梦神告之东走，回顾而身化为空桑。这是战国末的传说。
strings.scene.xia.yiyin.legend.intro: 伊水边的一棵空心老桑树里，传出了婴儿的哭声。采桑的女子把他抱回了有侁氏的国君那里。
strings.scene.xia.yiyin.end.legend: 空桑之子，负鼎之臣，都走到了汤的身边。汇流。
strings.scene.xia.yiyin.pick.whatif: 推演 · 若伊尹留在夏（未开放）

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

narration: 《殷本纪》里，伊尹最初只是一名陪嫁的厨子。有莘氏把女儿嫁给汤，伊尹背着鼎和砧板跟了过来。他借着讲烹调的滋味，向汤讲治国的道理。
汤任用了他。可伊尹又离开商，到夏去了一趟。
孟子说，伊尹五次去汤那里，五次去桀那里。
这一次，他在夏都看够了——
伊尹既丑有夏，复归于亳。他把在夏都看到的一切告诉了汤。不久，汤征葛伯，伐夏之战开始了。

strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.title: 鸣条
strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.subtitle: 商汤灭夏
strings.vo.01: 夏桀之时，诸侯多叛。商汤居亳，修德而众归之。
strings.vo.02: 伊尹相汤，伐葛伯、昆吾，夏之羽翼渐去。
strings.vo.03: 汤作誓，告其众曰：夏之罪多，天命殛之。
strings.vo.04: 汤率诸侯伐桀，桀败于有娀之虚，奔于鸣条。
strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.fork.prompt: 此刻落笔，循哪一卷而书？
strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.canon.intro: 汤先伐葛伯、昆吾，剪掉夏的羽翼；如今要对众人说清，为什么非伐夏不可。
strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.end.canon: 桀走鸣条，遂被放逐而死（《尚书》序称放于南巢）。汤即天子位，商代夏。
strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.legend.disclaimer: 以下取自《国语》《吕氏春秋》等书的说法，与《史记》叙述不同，史家多存疑。
strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.legend.intro: 《国语》说妺喜得宠，“与伊尹比而亡夏”；《吕氏春秋》又说伊尹曾奔夏三年，探听夏宫之事。
strings.scene.xia.mingtiao.end.legend: 伊尹回亳，汤遂出兵。异说的终点仍是鸣条之战。

style.zh: 中国传统水墨动画：宣纸纹理，焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨层次，干湿浓淡变化，枯笔飞白与泼墨，大面积留白；笔触随镜头逐笔生成，墨色在纸上自然晕开；水墨黑白灰为主，点缀色克制：咖啡色、驼色，朱砂红只用于印章、旗帜、血或火光的一点；人物以写意线描为主，面部简笔，不做写实刻画。
style.en: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

prompt.en:
[Ink-wash video prompt] Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE) · "鸣条" (商汤灭夏)

Format: 16:9 landscape (1920×1080; for 9:16 keep the subject centred), 24 fps, about 106 s total, 7 shots; generate shot by shot and edit together if a shot exceeds the generator's limit.

Style: Traditional Chinese ink-wash animation on xuan paper: layered ink tones from scorched black to pale wash, wet-and-dry brushwork, dry-brush flying-white strokes and splashed ink, generous negative space (liubai); strokes draw themselves on camera and bleed naturally into the paper; monochrome black-grey with restrained brown and tan accents and a touch of vermilion for seals, banners, blood or fire; figures in expressive xieyi line, simplified faces, not photorealistic.

Setting: Xia dynasty (c. 2070–1600 BCE), c. 1600 BCE — rammed-earth platforms and palaces, pottery, turquoise inlay, Yellow River plains.

Characters:
- Tang (汤) — ruler, 商 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in c. 1600 BCE
- Jie (桀) — ruler, 夏 camp; hemp cross-collar tunics, jade blades and axes, early bronze ornaments; sovereign's regalia, crown or ceremonial robe, commanding presence; age as historically attested in c. 1600 BCE
